name: RedNotebook Backup Import
changes: Save rules, Merge selected dates and the date toggles now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, when you select them. Nothing turns on or saves until Pro is on.
tip: You can import the same backup again. Notes that exist are skipped, so no duplicates are made.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. RedNotebook Backup Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
